scenarios.name: Initial state: count is 0, normal boundary status, button enabled
Single button click increments count to 1
Single documented shortcut key (ArrowUp) increments count to 2
Irrelevant keys leave state unchanged at 2
scenarios.input: Keys: ArrowDown, a, x, Enter, Escape, Tab, Shift, Space

scenarios.name: Alternating button click and ArrowUp increment cleanly to 6
Input field typing isolation: typing inside input does not trigger shortcut
Empty-input handling: submitting empty input is rejected and leaves state at 6
Invalid-input handling: submitting non-numeric "abc" is rejected and leaves state at 6
Invalid-input handling: submitting negative "-5" is rejected and leaves state at 6
Invalid-input handling: submitting out-of-boundary "99" is rejected and leaves state at 6
Valid manual input within boundary sets count to 8 and clears error
Increment to 9 via button, then to boundary 10 via ArrowUp
Exact boundary condition: at count 10, button is disabled and further ArrowUp keys do not exceed 10
scenarios.input: 3x ArrowUp + button click at max boundary

scenarios.name: Reset button restores count to 0 and clears boundary alert
Post-reset increment: button click increments count to 1
